regimes.name: Federal ordinary goods sales tax
regimes.applicability: Ordinary section 3 taxable goods supplies/imports in the 30 June 2026 consolidation.
conditions: Review product/PCT and registration.
Exclude exempt, zero-rated, reduced/specific and retail-price special branches first.
Complete commencement history and later notifications remain unreviewed.

regimes.name: Federal statutory zero-rated goods
regimes.applicability: Qualifying section 4 exports/Fifth Schedule goods only.
conditions: Retain qualifying supply/export evidence and all conditions/exclusions.
Distinct from exemption; review input/refund eligibility separately.

regimes.name: Federal exempt goods classification
regimes.applicability: Goods meeting a current section 13/Sixth Schedule exemption.
conditions: Null represents exemption classification, not a zero-percent rate.
Match exact entry/product/supply conditions; review attributable input restrictions.

regimes.name: Federal special goods and retail treatment
regimes.applicability: Retail-price, reduced/specific, additional or special-collection cases.
conditions: Resolve current Tier-1/other-retailer and product-specific treatment.
Review legal base, registration and invoicing/integration obligations.
Do not calculate on margin by default.

regimes.name: Medicines and pharmacy basket classification
regimes.applicability: Product rules at the relevant supply-chain stage.
conditions: Separate medicines, ingredients, devices and cosmetics.
Review schedule entry, product registration, stage and recoverability.
A pharmacy label does not exempt its whole basket.

regimes.name: Federal input eligibility and apportionment
regimes.applicability: Purchase/import tax potentially creditable against eligible obligations.
conditions: Review invoice/import evidence, business use, status and sections 7-8B restrictions.
Distinguish recoverable tax from expense/inventory/asset cost and apportion mixed use.
Cross-authority and reduced-rate credits require specific review.

regimes.name: ICT services tax classification
regimes.applicability: Services within the ICT Ordinance and applicable schedule/place rules.
conditions: 2025 indexed text is a baseline; current 2026 reconciliation remains pending.
Confirm service/place, recipient responsibility, registration and exemptions.
Restaurant tender conditions need current legal evidence.

regimes.name: Punjab services tax classification
regimes.applicability: Services with Punjab jurisdiction under applicable law.
conditions: Confirm service/place, registration, exclusions and recoverability.
Portal chapter links do not establish the complete current schedule.

regimes.name: Punjab restaurant and catering branches
regimes.applicability: Potential restaurant/catering services requiring current classification.
conditions: Obtain enacted current schedule and tender conditions.
Check chain/franchise, premises, authority permissions and integration.
No historic or news-summary rate is installed.

regimes.name: Sindh services tax classification
regimes.applicability: Services with Sindh jurisdiction under applicable law.
conditions: July 2026 editions are listed; complete rate/exemption reconciliation is pending.
Confirm CPC/service/place, registration, recoverability and recipient obligations.

regimes.name: Sindh food-service tender and permission branches
regimes.applicability: Potential restaurant/food/beverage serving service branches.
conditions: Current general schedule and conditions need review.
Record tender, integrated outlet status and any entity-specific permission.
Another taxpayer permission gives this business no entitlement.

regimes.name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa services tax classification
regimes.applicability: Services with KP jurisdiction under applicable law.
conditions: 2026 consolidation located; repeated body retrieval failed.
Do not treat the 2025 schedule as confirmed current.
Confirm service/territorial exclusions, registration, credits and recipient obligations.

regimes.name: KP restaurant tender and integration branches
regimes.applicability: Restaurant/hotel/food-service cases requiring a current category decision.
conditions: Historic official material shows tender, category and RIMS/invoicing conditions.
Reconcile 2026 law and later notifications before assigning rates.

regimes.name: Balochistan ordinary services tax
regimes.applicability: Section 10 general services rate in the 2026 consolidation.
conditions: Exclude current exempt/higher/reduced schedules.
Establish place, registration, credits and later amendments.
General-rate election for reduced-rate services requires applicable authority permission.

regimes.name: Balochistan restaurant schedule base branch
regimes.applicability: Current Third Schedule entry 1 branch before separately qualifying for reduced rate.
conditions: No input credit/adjustment.
Confirm category and any permitted general-rate election.
Do not combine with reduced or general services rates.

regimes.name: Balochistan eligible integrated-POS restaurant branch
regimes.applicability: Third Schedule entry 1 reduced restaurant branch amended by Finance Act 2026.
conditions: All POS machines BRA-linked to its satisfaction; all invoices/receipts issued electronically through POS.
No input credit/adjustment.
Excludes specified taxable hotel/motel/guest-house/club premises and franchiser/franchisee cases.
Reconcile current notifications and authority status.

regimes.name: Individual/AOP business income tax
regimes.applicability: Business taxable income of a proprietor/AOP where applicable.
conditions: Confirm legal form, tax year, bands, deductions and credits.
Separately review minimum/alternative/final regimes and surcharges.
Accounting profit does not determine taxable income.

regimes.name: Ordinary company income-tax candidate
regimes.applicability: Any other company category in First Schedule Part I Division II, June 2026 consolidation.
conditions: Exclude small-company/banking and other special categories.
Taxable-income rate, not total effective tax or an invoice charge.
Review tax year, super/minimum/alternative taxes, exemptions and credits.
Complete commencement history and later amendments unreviewed.

regimes.name: Defined small-company income-tax candidate
regimes.applicability: Small company as defined by the Income Tax Ordinance and current conditions.
conditions: Do not use SECP reporting-size thresholds as tax eligibility.
Review tax year, taxable base, other taxes and credits.
Complete commencement history and later amendments unreviewed.

regimes.name: Turnover minimum and alternative tax review
regimes.applicability: Potential section 113/113C and stream-specific obligations.
conditions: Confirm base, thresholds, exclusions, carry-forward and period.
Separate calculation from accounting classification/recoverability.
ICAP 2024 guidance excludes AFRS for SSEs; choose framework treatment.

regimes.name: Federal payment withholding and settlement
regimes.applicability: Potential deductions on goods/services/contracts, salary, rent and other covered payments.
conditions: Resolve section, payer duty, recipient status/ATL, exemption evidence, base and year.
Distinguish adjustable, minimum and final character.
Retain gross document value and linked certificates/remittance settlement.

regimes.name: Trade sales advance income-tax collection
regimes.applicability: Potential sections 236G/236H sales-chain collection.
conditions: Identify seller/buyer legal roles and status.
Separate advance collection from goods sales tax and retain credit evidence.
Do not impose an obsolete product-sector list.

regimes.name: Import/export income-tax collection review
regimes.applicability: Potential import, export-receipt and overseas-service consequences.
conditions: Resolve section, residence, year and adjustable/minimum/final nature.
Goods zero rating does not settle income tax on export receipts.
No universal exporter rate is seeded.

regimes.name: Authority-specific services withholding review
regimes.applicability: Potential recipient withholding under the selected services authority.
conditions: Select one jurisdiction and current instrument; this is not an executable rate.
Determine designated-agent/supplier status, base, exclusions and deposit/certificate duties.
Keep withholding payable distinct from expense and eligible input credit.

classification_questions: Where are services supplied and which authority applies?
Standalone, franchise/chain, catering or taxable hotel/club premises?
Which tenders, integrations and written permissions apply?
How are tips, charges, delivery platforms and refunds classified?
What legal form and documented exemption/approval apply?
Which receipts are dues, entrance fees, deposits, donations, dining or events?
Members, guests or public services, and where?
Which product/PCT and medicine/device/cosmetic evidence supports each item?
Importer, manufacturer, distributor, retailer or separate healthcare services?
How are expiry, returns and blocked/recoverable inputs documented?
Own-account goods trade or commission/agency services?
Which PCT items, import/export evidence and registrations apply?
What seller/buyer roles and advance-tax duties apply?
Own stock or agency, with what seller/buyer roles?
How are free goods/rebates, returns and freight classified?
Which trade advance-tax and integration rules apply?
Does current Tier-1 or another retailer regime apply?
Which mixed-basket classifications and acquisition-tax restrictions apply?
Are online/courier sales, branches, tenders and returns covered?
Separate parts/labor or a legally composite supply?
Which jurisdiction covers labor, subcontracting and warranty work?
Are customers withholding agents; who owns supplied parts?

open_questions: Complete enacted current Punjab, Sindh, KP and ICT schedules and subsequent notifications; partial access is not proof of a current rate.
Qualified Pakistan tax/accounting review must approve a stated entity/industry/transaction scope before any enablement.
Confirm legal commencement/end dates, tax points, registration thresholds, PCT/CPC/service classification, exemptions and territorial rules.
Define tax bases, inclusive pricing, exact rounding, mixed tenders, input apportionment, credits/returns and withholding settlement.
Reconcile income/minimum/alternative/final taxes, super tax, legal deductions and credit recoverability by year and framework.
Choose accounting framework independently of tax law; ICAP/ICMAP/ACCA professional guidance is not a tax rate or product certification.
Prove document/tax-control/subledger/core reconciliation with synthetic fixtures; this file implements no module behavior.
Customs/excise, local/professional levies, payroll detail and special areas need additional discovery; AJK/Gilgit-Baltistan and regulated sectors are outside this pass.
Filing, integrations, payments and automatic legal updates need separately authorized implementation; preserve historical rule snapshots.
